instruction: Set single line spacing as the default paragraph spacing for all new documents in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default paragraph line spacing for LibreOffice Writer to single/1.0 (100% represented as '100' in config). The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file to verify the ProportionalValue setting under Paragraph/LineSpacing. Similar difficulty to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the LibreOffice user configuration file from the correct path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu)
Metric function correctly parses XML and searches for the right configuration path: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/Defaults/Paragraph/LineSpacing/ProportionalValue
Expected value '100' correctly represents single line spacing (100% = 1.0 line spacing)
Metric correctly handles the 'expected' parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses rules['line_spacing'] without incorrectly trying to access 'rules' key
Comparison logic is correct: strict string equality between actual and expected spacing values
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (default paragraph line spacing)
Handles edge cases properly: missing file, XML parsing errors, and missing config values all return 0
The verification approach is semantically sound - checking the LibreOffice config file is the correct way to verify default settings
